reason: Holds. The workflow node set (logic.compare, action.notify_desktop, ai.agent_invoke) is registered, but nothing re-runs a workflow on a timer or event. The sidecar has no scheduler, cron or recurring-run mechanism, and the only frontend interval is the delegate-runs status poll. So BLUEPRINT UC3 ('alert on entry trigger') and UC5 ('monitors news -> notifications') only work if the user re-runs the workflow by hand, and no separate price-alert feature exists either. One nuance: the repro says 'close the app', but a sidecar scheduler would stop with the app too. The fix only covers the app-open case, which is still the core promise, so severity stays high.
evidence_checked: Opened the node registrations and the notify_desktop handler. `find sidecar src src-tauri -iname '*schedul*'` returned nothing. grepped schedul|cron|recurring|periodic|interval|trigger across workflow_engine.py, routers/workflow.py, workflow_store.py and workflow_nodes/*: the only hits are the OHLCV 'interval' config and the static 'trigger' node category. grepped alert|notif across sidecar (non-test): only the workflow_nodes files.
repro_check: find sidecar src src-tauri -iname '*schedul*' (empty); grep -rniE 'schedul|cron|recurring' sidecar/services/workflow_engine.py sidecar/routers/workflow.py sidecar/services/workflow_store.py (no hits)

reason: It is true that no doc or test had measured it before, but the risk the finding raises (that the <30s bar could turn out false at launch) is disproved by a direct measurement. Three timed runs of a 60-trading-day backtest over the full HTTP path on the isolated stack took 0.5-2.1s, about 15x under the bar, including a 3-symbol run with fresh data fetches. A missing wall-clock assertion in CI would not change any decision, and such assertions are flaky on shared runners anyway.
evidence_checked: Opened the Phase 8 deferral, the BLUEPRINT success criterion, and the backtest route/request model. Ran 3 timed POST /backtest/run requests through scripts/r15/vy.py against :52152. Each returned run-complete with totalBars=62 and metrics.
